reversibility_tests.name: public multi-state preparation
reversibility_tests.law: at least three answer-blind public carrier states are prospectively prepared and distinguished

reversibility_tests.name: frozen multivariate state vector
reversibility_tests.law: state vector, covariance, hierarchy, and equivalence region are frozen from public calibration only

reversibility_tests.name: nondestructive repeated tomography
reversibility_tests.law: measurement disturbance is bounded and the same carrier can be observed after every primitive

reversibility_tests.name: persistent object identity
reversibility_tests.law: allocation, page identity, line-set identity, process custody, and carrier ID remain fixed through the word

reversibility_tests.name: post-source challenge secrecy
reversibility_tests.law: source cannot inherit the realized word, seed, operator schedule, or accumulator target

reversibility_tests.name: directional backend receipts
reversibility_tests.law: each operation binds acting core, prior owner proxy, destination owner proxy, route, line set, amplitude, and completion

reversibility_tests.name: injectivity collision screen
reversibility_tests.law: distinct held-out pre-states remain distinguishable after each candidate forward map

reversibility_tests.name: left inverse law
reversibility_tests.law: T_inverse(T(s)) is equivalent to s for every held-out starting-state stratum

reversibility_tests.name: right inverse law
reversibility_tests.law: T(T_inverse(s)) is equivalent to s for every held-out starting-state stratum

reversibility_tests.name: wrong-inverse rejection
reversibility_tests.law: wrong core, route, direction, line set, amplitude, partial inverse, and inverse order fail under the same equivalence law

reversibility_tests.name: held-out composition law
reversibility_tests.law: single fitted generator maps predict unseen pairs, powers, contractible words, and cancellation words

reversibility_tests.name: commutator orientation and nulls
reversibility_tests.law: commutator and inverse commutator reverse orientation while contractible, disjoint-support, commuting-pair, and carrier-off controls are null

reversibility_tests.name: causal independent accumulator
reversibility_tests.law: output depends on carrier transport, vanishes carrier-off and word-only replay, and is decoupled before inverse restoration

reversibility_tests.name: inverse restoration with retained output
reversibility_tests.law: inverse commutator restores the full frozen carrier state while the independent output remains

reversibility_tests.name: system-plus-environment accounting
reversibility_tests.law: cache, coherence, page, timing, frequency, temperature, process, measurement, accumulator, and external bath fields are classified
